method: All published JSON manuscripts and actual HTTPS HTML captured in parent crawl examined; no content mutations.

Compared every introduction, place/practical paragraph, itinerary item, FAQ question/answer and conclusion against server HTML with Unicode/whitespace normalization, excluding script/style text. Collapsed FAQ details are server HTML, not JavaScript-dependent content.

Checked one H1, all recommendation/practical H2 headings, title/metadescription/canonical, reciprocal ES/EN hreflang, Article schema type/headline/language/URL/unchanged dates, full editorial structure, source-evidence presence, and final content approval hashes.

Compared exact complete-body fingerprints, repeated paragraphs of at least12words and eight-word-shingle similarity within each language. Similarity is a triage measure, not a plagiarism verdict or Google indexing rule.
Length is descriptive, not a ranking requirement. Shorter entries retained for editorial review rather than padded, removed or assigned noindex.

editorialTriage.scope: Outline-level editorial triage of all16versions below1200words: titles, stated search intent, introduction, developed section headings/paragraph lengths, logistics and specificFAQ answers examined. Full server HTML presence and source metadata checked for all372versions.
findings: The16shorter versions are1067–1199words and have complete introductions, itineraries, conclusions and fourFAQanswers; they are not empty pages or teaser translations.

Examples: Verona andPisa each develop five distinct places plus admission/route planning; Osaka, Venice andFukuokaChristmas guides each develop three actual venues plus programme-specific dates, transport, booking and holiday distinctions.
Concise five-place lists and three-venue event guides can answer a proportionate intent. No automatic rewrite, padding, deletion or noindex is warranted from these lengths.

No exact duplicate article bodies, paragraph copies≥12words, duplicate localized article titles or duplicate localized article descriptions found. No pair crossed the stated shingle-similarity triage thresholds.
No explicit Lorem Ipsum, uppercase TBD/TODO:, or INSERT placeholders in published manuscript bodies. Ordinary Spanish «todo:» is not a placeholder.
editorialTriage.limits: This identifies technical completeness and duplication candidates, not a Google quality score or a guarantee that Google will index every useful article. No minimum word count is asserted. None of the private79discovered or11crawled URL examples is available in this audit.
